narrative:
Lawrence County has 39,152 registered voters, with 56.7% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 30.6% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 12.6%, a pronounced Republican lean of 18.0 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 27.2% of registrants.
